name: fade + scroll
description: Captions stay hidden during native scrolling and fade in after a settled photograph remains ready for two seconds.

files.fade-scroll.js: createFadeScroll(container,{itemSelector,delay}) with refresh()/destroy(); never writes scroll position.
files.fade-scroll.css: Opacity-only 1s ease-in-out reveal; instant hide on new activity.
files.fade-scroll.test.mjs: Run node --test fade-scroll.test.mjs; twelve timing and interruption/lifecycle tests.
files.index.json: Combined feature entry and integration notes.

integration: Use a native snapping photo container, with each fitting photo marked data-scroll-item and a figcaption.
Add data-fade-scroll to the container in initial HTML to keep captions hidden before JavaScript starts.
Use the existing momentum-scroll controller for native momentum/selection. Its active-item callback must not start caption timers.

timing.hide: immediate; never a fade-out during scrolling

behavior: Initial fully settled photograph receives the same two-second delay.
Input or any scroll cancels pending reveal and hides all captions immediately.
Reveal requires start alignment within 1 CSS pixel and full viewport fit; only the settled photo is revealed.
Photograph must be loaded before the full delay begins.
Legacy browsers and no-movement input use quiet/stable checks; no scroll animation is introduced.
Resize, backgrounding, BFCache restoration and held gestures invalidate/rearm the delay safely.
read_more: Text only; no destination was provided and no link behavior was added.
reduced_motion: After two seconds of stillness, show the predominant photo caption without a fade or forced snap; this preserves readability when native snapping is disabled by the existing reduced-motion policy.

validation.automated: 12 tests passed; syntax and markup checks passed.
